CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Sampang Regency. 2. Regional Government is the administration of government affairs by the Regional Government and DPRD according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 3. Regent is the Regent of Sampang. 4. Regional Secretary is the Regional Secretary of Sampang Regency. 5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regional Head and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of Government Affairs which are the authority of the Region. 6. Family Planning Office for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter referred to as DKBP3A is a Regional Apparatus Organization that has the main duties and functions in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection in Sampang Regency. 7. Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old, including a child who is still in the womb. 8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court decisions; 9. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights, so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination; 10. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 12. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, mentally, socially, psychosocially, and sexually. 13. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or defects to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death. 14. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 15. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes. 16. Discrimination is any restriction, harassment, or exclusion that is directly or indirectly based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, group, class, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life. 17. Victim is a woman including Female Workers who work abroad and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence. 18. Women's Empowerment is any effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social capacity, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities. 19. Gender equality and justice is equal opportunity between men and women to participate in the development process, equal access to all forms of services, and have a balanced social and economic status. 20. Integrated service is a series of activities to provide protection for victims of violence including criminal acts of trafficking in persons carried out jointly by relevant agencies or institutions as a unified implementation of health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance; 21. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A is an integrated service institution for victims of violence against women and children; 22. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will, is or has occurred. 23. Women's empowerment and child protection system is the entire process of organizing women's empowerment and child protection carried out comprehensively, inclusively, integratively starting from the stage of report/complaint handling services, health services, social rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal assistance up to repatriation and social reintegration for women and children victims of crime and violence to their social environment; 24. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree. 25. Legal act is any act or action of a legal subject that has legal consequences and the legal consequences are indeed desired by the legal subject. 26. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred; 27. Companion is a person who has the expertise to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence. 28.

Article 3

The Women's Empowerment and Child Protection System aims to:
a. improve the quality of life of women, children, and the quality of families;
b. enhance the institutional capacity of women's empowerment and child protection in the regions, including the development of gender and child data systems; and
c. provide protection of women's rights and fulfillment of children's rights including special protection for children from various forms of violence and other discriminatory treatment.

Article 2

Letter b

What is meant by the principle of the best interests of the child is that in all actions concerning children carried out by the government, society, legislative bodies, and judicial bodies, the best interests of the child must be the primary consideration.

Letter e
Gender equality means equal conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and participate in political, legal, economic, social and cultural activities, education and national defense and security, as well as equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Letter f
Gender justice is a process and fair treatment of women and men. Gender justice means there is no stereotyping of roles, double burden, subordination, marginalization and violence against women or men

Article 22

Monitoring and evaluation are intended to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities that have been established. Monitoring is carried out periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of Regional Apparatus Organizations that implement policies, programs, and activities for the empowerment of women and children victims of violence. This monitoring is carried out from planning to implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the empowerment of women and children victims of violence for the current year and evaluation will be conducted at the end of each fiscal year.

Article 16

Implementation Guidelines and/or Technical Guidelines for P2TP2A contain technical matters regarding services for handling women and children victims of violence including service personnel, facilities and infrastructure, rights and obligations of victims, referral systems including handling starting from complaint services, medical rehabilitation services, social rehabilitation services, spiritual guidance services, repatriation and social reintegration services. In addition, it also contains service flow and Standard Operating Procedures for each service.

Article 10

Rehabilitative efforts as referred to in Article 6 are as follows:
a. providing companion personnel for victims of crime and violence which include among others psychologists, psychiatrists, clergy/spiritual companions, lawyers, medical personnel;
b. strengthening work networks and coordination in the reintegration process and repatriation of victims to their families and/or social environment.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

CHAPTER VI

PARTICIPATION

Article 21

The community, business world, academics, and other professional groups may participate in the implementation of the women's empowerment and child protection system.

Article 6

In order to implement the objectives as referred to in Article 3 letter c, the Regional Government carries out promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative efforts in accordance with statutory provisions.

CHAPTER III

WOMEN'S EMPOWERMENT AND CHILD PROTECTION SYSTEM

Article 11

The Regional Government assisted by regional apparatus must have a strong commitment to build a comprehensive, inclusive and integrative women's empowerment and child protection system.

Article 19

P2TP2A may consult and coordinate with the Ministry that administers women's empowerment and child protection affairs by first coordinating with Regional Apparatus or other units that handle women's empowerment and child protection.

CHAPTER V

COORDINATION MECHANISM

Article 18

In carrying out the functions as referred to in Article 15, coordination is carried out with Regional Apparatus or other units that handle women's empowerment and child protection.

Social worker is a person who has the expertise to listen empathically and explore problems to provide counseling in an effort to strengthen the victim psychologically. 29. Medicolegal is an effort to collect evidence for the purposes of proof in the judicial process. 30. Women's Crisis Center is a service center for women and children victims of violence. 31. Safe House is a temporary residence for victims, in order to obtain a sense of security and not be reached by the perpetrator or the perpetrator's messenger, while the case has not been resolved. 32. Standard Operational Procedure hereinafter referred to as SOP is a procedure that serves as a reference for service actions established by Regent's Decree. 33. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 25

This Regional Regulation comes into force from the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Sampang Regency.

Article 15

P2TP2A is one form of integrated service unit that functions as:
a. an information center for women and children;
b. a service center for women and children victims of violence; and
c. an empowerment center for women and children.

WOMEN'S EMPOWERMENT AND CHILD PROTECTION

REGENT OF SAMPANG

PROVINCE OF EAST JAVA

CHAPTER III

WOMEN'S EMPOWERMENT AND CHILD PROTECTION SYSTEM

Article 11

The Regional Government assisted by regional apparatus must have a strong commitment to build a comprehensive, inclusive and integrative women's empowerment and child protection system.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

CHAPTER VI

PARTICIPATION

Article 21

The community, business world, academics, and other professional groups may participate in the implementation of the women's empowerment and child protection system.

Article 19

P2TP2A may consult and coordinate with the Ministry that administers women's empowerment and child protection affairs by first coordinating with Regional Apparatus or other units that handle women's empowerment and child protection.

In addition, it also contains service flow and Standard Operating Procedures for each service.

Article 22

Monitoring and evaluation are intended to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities that have been established. This monitoring is carried out from planning to implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the empowerment of women and children victims of violence for the current year and evaluation will be conducted at the end of each fiscal year.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 19

P2TP2A may consult and coordinate with the Ministry that administers women's empowerment and child protection affairs by first coordinating with Regional Apparatus or other units that handle women's empowerment and child protection.

Article 14

P2TP2A is under the coordination of DKBP3A or other units that handle women's empowerment and child protection.

Article 16

P2TP2A institutional structure:
a. is established based on a Regent/Sub-district Head decree;
b. its membership comes from structural and non-structural elements originating from professionals, academics, community leaders; and
c. the source of funding for the establishment, development, and strengthening of P2TP2A is sourced from the APBD and other legitimate and non-binding sources based on statutory provisions.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Sampang Regency. 2. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regional Head and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of Government Affairs which are the authority of the Region. 6. Family Planning Office for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter referred to as DKBP3A is a Regional Apparatus Organization that has the main duties and functions in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection in Sampang Regency. 7. Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old, including a child who is still in the womb. 8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court decisions; 9. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights, so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination; 10. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life. 12. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, mentally, socially, psychosocially, and sexually. 13. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or defects to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death. 14. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person. 15. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree. 25. 1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 11

The Regional Government assisted by regional apparatus must have a strong commitment to build a comprehensive, inclusive and integrative women's empowerment and child protection system.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

1. GENERAL

The Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates local governments to regulate and manage their own regions in order to realize the welfare of the community through improved services, empowerment and community participation. One of the authorities of local government is to make regional policies with the aim of improving the welfare of the people in their regions.

In addition, the constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has also mandated in Article 28D Paragraph 1 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia that every person has the right to recognition, guarantee, protection, and fair legal certainty as well as equal treatment before the law. Article 28B Paragraph 2 also states that every child has the right to survival, growth, and development and has the right to protection from violence and discrimination. This shows that children and women should be protected by the state, especially against violence because their rights are already regulated in the constitution.

Therefore, it is necessary to make efforts to prevent and eradicate all forms of discrimination and violence against women and children, especially for the Sampang Regency area. The Government of Sampang Regency is one of the most authorized parties in carrying out women's empowerment and child protection by implementing and formulating regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and child protection.

One form of such regulation is the Regional Regulation of Sampang Regency. The regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 16

In addition, it also contains service flow and Standard Operating Procedures for each service.
